facts.fact: Veronica 命令 Nick 闭眼伸手，把藏在背后的礼物递给他
facts.anchor: “Close your eyes and stick out your hands,” Veronica commanded

facts.fact: Veronica 说毛衣是她亲手织的，作为生日礼物
facts.anchor: “I knitted it for you,” said Veronica. “Happy Birthday, my honey.”

facts.fact: Veronica 说早上在办公桌前读情报流量时织毛衣，免得脑子另一部分无聊
facts.anchor: “I knit at my desk in the morning while I read the traffic,” she said.

facts.fact: 她赶在 Nick 出行前织完，并说加德满都会冷得要命
facts.anchor: “It’s going to be fucking cold in Kathmandu.”

facts.fact: Nick 有把衣物落在酒店房间的历史，Veronica 说丢了毛衣就要重新考虑爱他
facts.anchor: Nick had a history of leaving various items of clothing behind in hotel rooms

facts.fact: Veronica 说前方作战基地的自杀式炸弹袭击改变了一切，并承认 Nick 是对的
facts.anchor: the suicide bombing at Forward Operating Base ███████ changed everything

facts.fact: Nick 订好了回来后的位子，地点是 The Inn at Little Washington，还要去 Monkey Bar、骑摩托车
facts.anchor: “I made that reservation we talked about, for when I get back.”

facts.fact: 两人做好烤鸡配红土豆、炒菠菜和面包，烛光下边吃边听 Kind of Blue
facts.anchor: a roasted chicken with red potatoes
